mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment ( post_id, user_id, comment_content, comment_date, comment_last_modified ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{userId}, #{commentContent}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, post_id, user_id, comment_content, comment_date, comment_last_modified, deleted_at FROM comment WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY comment_date ASC
SELECT comment_id, post_id, user_id, comment_content, comment_date, comment_last_modified, deleted_at FROM comment WHERE comment_id = #{commentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT comment_id, post_id, user_id, comment_content, comment_date, comment_last_modified, deleted_at FROM comment WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY comment_date DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET comment_content = #{commentContent}, comment_last_modified = NOW() WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
